title: Understanding the chemistry of re-emerging proton batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00746A, Review Article
Usman Ghani, Farman Ullah, Junying Zhang, Bingqing Ye, Shitong Wang, Xingke Cai, Jun Lu
From fundamental mechanisms to practical challenges, this review highlights how engineered proton channels and water frameworks pave the way for next-generation, wide-temperature-range proton batteries.
